name: Randolph Berg
source:
There is no mistaking him for anything but a privileged asshole. The second husband of Donna Berg, formerly Donna Aelswith, born Donna Newhall. Her father was a construction tycoon who started the company Newhall Development and is responsible for Donna being one of the wealthiest women in Rackham City and in the country. Randolph is currently the CEO of Newhall Development. He's also a self-serving individual who appears to have some ties to the Bellarosa crime syndicate or in short "The Band."

[Edited from in-game description]
